name: bandit.scout_to_decision_observer_live_mcw
description: Observer-backed vertical probe from an idle zero-lead bandit camp at (164,39,0), with the player at (162,36,0), two OMTs west and one OMT south of the sector-0 inner waypoint at (164,35,0), and the sector-0 outer target at (164,30,0) on the existing continuous x=164 north-south road. Production discovers local leads and reaches its stable-ID-derived 13-hour frontier deadline, then dispatches and hands off the sector-0 pair through the real route. A selected-entity capture-and-continue watch follows an initial six-hour natural window before authoritative survivor-return, final-report, and camp-decision audit.

steps.label: post_load_scout_to_decision_observer_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: the derived zero-lead observer fixture reaches normal gameplay

steps.label: preflight_idle_zero_lead_camp
steps.abort_reason: saved state was not the idle five-member, zero-lead, zero-outing causal boundary
steps.expected_immediate_state: five ready members, zero leads, and no active outing exist before production cadence starts

steps.label: wait_first_6_hours_toward_real_dispatch
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: the real wait menu is opened before choosing six hours
steps.expected_visible_fact: six ordinary game hours initialize and advance the production structural cadence

steps.label: wait_second_6_hours_toward_frontier_deadline
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: the real wait menu is opened before choosing six hours
steps.expected_visible_fact: production has naturally discovered the local terrain but remains before this camp identity's frontier deadline

steps.label: wait_1_hour_for_real_frontier_dispatch
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: the real wait menu is opened before choosing one hour
steps.expected_visible_fact: production reaches the ID-derived deadline and dispatches the exact pair on frontier sector zero

steps.label: wait_3_hours_for_real_pair_handoff
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: the real wait menu is opened before choosing three hours
steps.expected_visible_fact: three ordinary game hours reach the local-handoff boundary without requiring the hourly scheduler to run before the wait UI returns
steps.failure_rule: The wait may finish exactly on the boundary; the following ordinary turn and log audit own proof of handoff and cohesion.

steps.label: wait_5_minutes_through_real_pair_handoff_cadence
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: the real wait menu is opened before choosing five minutes
steps.expected_visible_fact: five ordinary game minutes cross the overmap-NPC cadence and let production consume the reached handoff boundary
steps.failure_rule: The following whole-run log audit owns the one-shot handoff/cohesion proof whether production emits it at the three-hour endpoint or during this cadence wait.

steps.label: audit_real_pair_handoff_and_cohesion
steps.abort_reason: the bounded five-minute cadence wait did not commit and assemble the exact production pair
steps.expected_immediate_state: the exact production pair is locally owned and assembled on its shared route

steps.label: open_overmap_for_authoritative_dispatch
steps.expected_visible_fact: DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE opens the read-only ecology overlay

steps.label: select_authoritative_dispatch
steps.expected_visible_fact: the overlay selects the production-owned exact pair

steps.label: settled_reselect_authoritative_dispatch
steps.abort_reason: the settled overmap redraw did not bind the exact T01 dispatch identity BD-DF9E73
steps.expected_visible_fact: the exact T01 dispatch alias BD-DF9E73 is selected after the overmap redraw boundary

steps.label: open_console_for_natural_watch
steps.expected_visible_fact: the shared ecology console opens for the retained authoritative selection

steps.label: arm_default_capture_and_continue_watch
steps.abort_reason: the ecology console did not arm the exact T01 dispatch identity BD-DF9E73
steps.expected_visible_fact: the exact T01 dispatch identity BD-DF9E73 is armed in capture-and-continue mode

steps.label: close_console_before_natural_window
steps.expected_visible_fact: normal gameplay resumes with the watch armed and no ecology intervention

steps.label: advance_initial_6_hour_post_observation_window
steps.pre_menu_expected_visible_fact: the real wait menu is opened before the initial six-hour observer window
steps.expected_visible_fact: six ordinary game hours let production movement, watch assessment, egress, physical return, report delivery, and decision acceptance run if their real deadlines fit
steps.failure_rule: If the pair has not returned by this first bounded window, retain the incident as honest no-progress or intermediate evidence; do not inject completion.

steps.label: reopen_console_after_natural_window
steps.expected_visible_fact: the console reopens with the selected entity's bounded transition deltas

steps.label: record_post_window_ecology_incident
steps.expected_visible_fact: the retained already-armed exact terminal identity publishes one compact incident JSON and screenshot pair with natural deltas and an empty intervention ledger
steps.failure_rule: Coordinator artifact inspection must confirm the fresh pair retains the original exact armed identity, natural provenance, debug_intervention=false, and no intervention ledger entries.

steps.label: audit_fresh_post_window_ecology_incident_pair
steps.abort_reason: the post-window R action did not publish one fresh identity-bound natural incident JSON/PNG pair
steps.expected_immediate_state: the current unique run directory contains one newly published same-stem incident JSON/PNG pair bound to this scenario, runtime, selection, and natural delta history

steps.label: close_console_before_final_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: normal gameplay resumes without any debug edit

steps.label: audit_same_run_survivor_physical_return
steps.abort_reason: the initial six-hour post-observation window did not show the exact pair's physical return
steps.expected_immediate_state: the same-run production log records at least one scout returned from the selected frontier outing

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_before_scout_to_decision_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: the pre-save player mtime is recorded

steps.label: open_save_prompt_after_scout_to_decision_window
steps.abort_reason: the case-sensitive save-and-quit prompt was not visible

steps.label: confirm_scout_to_decision_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: the final world state is written after the natural observer window

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_after_scout_to_decision_save
steps.abort_reason: the saved-player mtime did not advance after final save

steps.label: audit_saved_survivors_home_and_outing_closed
steps.abort_reason: saved authority did not show a real survivor home, a closed outing, a final observed report, and the report-awaiting-assessment decision pinned to that exact report
steps.expected_immediate_state: at least four living members, including one scout carrier, are home; the outing is closed, and the final observed report is pinned by the report-awaiting-assessment decision

evidence_contract.claim: from an idle zero-lead camp on the continuous x=164 road, production naturally discovers terrain, reaches its ID-derived frontier deadline, dispatches and physically hands off an exact pair, exposes that authoritative pair to the shared observer, records one natural incident, and returns at least one scout carrier home
evidence_contract.preconditions_and_interventions: the source fixture establishes only the idle five-member camp at (164,39,0), zero evidence, the road-connected sector-0 outer target (164,30,0), and deterministic clock; the southwest derived fixture preserves DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE and moves only the player observer from (162,35,0) to (162,36,0), two OMTs west and one OMT south of the same route waypoint at (164,35,0); the scenario performs no ecology edit
evidence_contract.causal_boundary: fixture installation ends before terrain discovery, dispatch, local handoff, observation, assessment, egress, return, report, or decision
evidence_contract.real_code_path: hourly structural terrain scan and scheduler -> exact-pair dispatch -> route/local handoff and cohesion -> production observation and assessment -> return ownership -> report delivery and camp decision acceptance
evidence_contract.expected_transition: idle/no-lead -> natural terrain memory -> due frontier lead -> exact local pair -> meaningful selected-entity delta -> at-least-one-survivor physical return -> final report -> report-awaiting-assessment decision
evidence_contract.negative_control: preflight requires zero leads and zero outing; the incident must report natural provenance, debug_intervention=false, and an empty intervention ledger
evidence_contract.timeout: two six-hour waits plus one one-hour wait reach the ID-derived frontier deadline, followed by the next three hourly structural advances and one initial six-hour post-observation window; no completion state may be injected
evidence_contract.pass_fail_rule: The row is green only when preflight, exact production dispatch/handoff, observer selection/watch, natural incident pair, at least one same-run scout survivor home, save writeback, closed outing, final non-provisional report, and report-to-decision identity match are all green. Return is owned by the post-window live-log audit and final saved-state audit, not by the bounded wait-menu completion token, so an intermediate no-progress incident remains capturable.
evidence_contract.observer_artifact_requirement: Coordinator inspection must find one post-window ecology_incident JSON/PNG pair for the selected canonical ID with natural provenance, debug_intervention=false, and an empty intervention ledger.
evidence_contract.identity_requirement: The run artifact must retain commit, binary, fixture, scenario, selected canonical ID, and observer-tool identities.
